## Professional Summary

I identify problems, simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary work, and build practical solutions. With 14+ years in complex, high-reliability manufacturing (Motorola, Samsung, Huawei, Sony, Alcatel), I bridge Quality, Engineering, and Production on the plant floor. ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 Internal Auditor with working knowledge of TS16949 and ANSI/ESD S20.20, applying practical Lean tools (line balancing, standard work, VSM) and building custom digital tools to resolve bottlenecks, lower costs, reduce defects, and improve process reliability.

## Core Competencies (4 Demonstrated Pillars)

- **Problem Solving**: Root Cause Analysis (RCA - 5 Whys, 8D, Ishikawa), Closed-Loop CAPA, Failure Analysis (Reliability), Data Analysis & Diagnostics.
- **Process Improvement**: Line Balancing (+17% prod achieved), Standard Work & Ergonomics, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kaizen & Workplace Optimization.
- **Quality Systems & Standards**: Internal Auditor: ISO 9001 · ISO 14001 · ISO 45001; Working Knowledge: IATF 16949 (formerly TS 16949) · ISO/IEC 17025 · ANSI/ESD S20.20; Quality Tools: FMEA · Control Plans · SPC · CAPA · Root Cause Analysis; Project Management Expert (UTN FRBA).
- **Digital Solutions & Applied AI**: Custom Web Apps for Operations (PCB Defect Recorder, ISO Compliance Analyzer), Applied AI for Operations, Workflow Automation, Zero Paperwork & Bureaucracy Reduction.
- **Languages**: Spanish (Native), English (B2 | Professional Working Proficiency), Portuguese (Beginner).

## What I Have Improved (Problem → Action → Measurable Impact)

- **+17% Production Increase (Alcatel 4007)**: Problem: assembly-line bottlenecks and station cycle time imbalances. Action: rebalanced Lean line operations and optimized workstation ergonomics. Impact: 17% production increase delivered while simultaneously exceeding First Pass Yield targets.
- **+10% Planned Production Exceeded (Alcatel 4015)**: Problem: tactical flow constraints during production ramp-up. Action: stabilized continuous process flow and cycle times. Impact: exceeded planned production by 10%, reducing defect rates and improving process reliability.
- **-3 Operator Roles Reallocated (Samsung Microwave)**: Problem: excess labor cost and uneven workstation loading. Action: applied Lean line rebalancing and standard task reallocation. Impact: successfully reallocated 3 operator roles, lowering manufacturing labor costs without compromising reliability.
- **-2 Days Onboarding Time Cut (Launch Training Model)**: Problem: slow operator learning curve during rapid product launches. Action: designed a peer-to-peer 1-on-1 coaching program between experienced and incoming shift workers. Impact: cut onboarding time by 2 days while achieving full required quality from day one.
- **Closed-Loop CAPA Success**: Problem: repetitive defect patterns in complex electronics manufacturing. Action: led deep root-cause investigations (Ishikawa, 5 Whys) and implemented robust preventive controls. Impact: permanently eliminated recurrence of critical defects across multiple production lines.
- **Global Brands Compliance**: Problem: demanding, diverse technical quality requirements from international clients. Action: coordinated specifications with Asian suppliers, audited process lines, and enforced APQP control plans. Impact: zero critical customer audit findings and sustained technical sign-off for Motorola, Samsung, Huawei, Sony, and Alcatel.

## Professional Experience

### Grupo BGH — Quality Management & Continuous Improvement
*May 2025 – Present | Full-time | On-site | Tierra del Fuego, Argentina*
- **Repetitive shop-floor defects**: Analyzed root causes via 5 Whys/Ishikawa and implemented closed-loop CAPA, reducing defect rates and improving process reliability.
- **Imported component non-conformances**: Identified quality gaps, coordinated corrective actions with Asian suppliers, and redesigned plant traceability controls, preventing line stoppages.
- **Slow manual data logging**: Built lightweight digital tools and automated visual logging workflows, simplifying reporting and eliminating spreadsheet bureaucracy.

### Grupo BGH — ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 Internal Auditor
*October 2022 – Present | Part-time / Parallel Function*
- **Compliance gaps and redundant paperwork**: Analyzed operational processes during integrated audits and implemented actionable findings, securing full compliance and simplifying procedures.
- **Safety and quality process deviations**: Identified operational risks and coordinated closed-loop corrective action plans with area leads, reducing recurrence and strengthening prevention.

### Grupo BGH — Process Technician | Manufacturing Process & Workstation Design
*August 2019 – February 2024*
*Manufacturing process design, workstation layout, line balancing, and operator training:*
- **Assembly line flow instability**: Redesigned process flows and implemented Statistical Process Control (SPC) on critical parameters, improving repeatability and reducing downtime.
- **Cross-shift operational variability**: Designed workstation layouts, simplified work instructions, and conducted hands-on standardized work workshops, training shop-floor operators and reducing defects.

### Grupo BGH — Process Technician — Metrology & Engineering Laboratory
*February 2017 – August 2019*
*Relocated to Metrology & Engineering Laboratory following the closure of the Mobile Phones division. Calibration under ISO 17025:*
- **Measurement drift in high-frequency equipment**: Calibrated RF generators, GPS systems, and Hi-Pot testers under ISO 17025, securing uninterrupted traceability and reducing measurement uncertainty.
- **Unscheduled test station drift**: Implemented preventive calibration schedules and reference checks, eliminating line stoppages caused by out-of-spec test equipment.

### Grupo BGH — Process Technician | Acting Process Engineering Responsibilities
*March 2014 – February 2017*
*Assumed process engineering responsibilities after the Process Engineer position became vacant, managing the launch and stabilization of Alcatel and global brand production lines:*
- **Alcatel 4007 (+17% prod) & Alcatel 4015 (+10% prod)**: Redesigned line balancing and workstation ergonomics, eliminating bottlenecks and exceeding First Pass Yield targets.
- **Samsung Microwave line (-3 operator roles)**: Analyzed cycle times and reallocated standard work, lowering manufacturing labor costs without compromising reliability.
- **Launch training model (-2 days onboarding)**: Designed and implemented a peer-to-peer 1-on-1 cross-shift coaching program, achieving full required quality from day one.
- **Global brand technical compliance**: Implemented APQP, PFMEA, and Control Plans, coordinating component quality resolutions directly with suppliers in China for 5+ global brands.

### Grupo BGH — NPI Quality Analyst (New Product Introduction)
*May 2012 – February 2014*
- **Deviation risks on new models**: Audited industrialization ramp-ups under ISO 9001 and ISO/TS 16949, identifying and closing operational gaps before mass production start.
- **Lack of standardized inspection guidelines**: Built Control Plans, visual inspection work instructions, and participated in PFMEAs, securing critical parameter control.
- **Technical discrepancies with overseas vendors**: Translated English engineering specifications and coordinated component non-conformity resolutions directly with suppliers in China.

## Proprietary Software & AI Projects

1. **PCB Defect Recorder**: Eliminates slow manual spreadsheet logging and transcription errors on the shop floor. Enables operators to log defects with a single click directly onto real board images, generating real-time heatmaps and immediate diagnostics for process engineering. (URL: https://guillermocanete.github.io/DefectRecorder/)
2. **ISO Compliance Analyzer**: Eliminates hours of manual document review and late non-conformance detection in management system audits. Automatically scans process documentation against ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001 clauses to spot compliance gaps before auditors arrive.
